invariants.rationale: The method retrieves a Drawable using the name, so it is likely intended that name is not null.
The method returns a tinted drawable, requiring that tint should not be null.
An empty string is unlikely to be a valid name for getDrawable; it is probable that name is non-empty.
In libGDX, Color alpha values typically range from 0.0f to 1.0f.
Drawable names are unlikely to have leading or trailing whitespace.
